summary: A twin-gabled half-timbered burgage warehouse runs right through the block. It is dark oak frame with white calcite daub under two steep slate gables, and both street faces are the same: hoist beams and stacked loading doors in each gable, and two jettied storeys over a ground floor of open shop counters. The six wood merchants are meshed back to back, three per street, each dressed in its own wood, with a stair lobby at the west end and a cart passage through the block at the east end.
concept_subject: A long timber market hall for a lumber wholesaler, running from one cobbled street through to the next. It stands on a pale andesite pavement and shows the same proud face to both streets. Above, two steep slate gables stand side by side with a valley between them, and a louvred vent monitor runs along each ridge. Every gable is half-timbered with dark oak posts, Mann-figure braces and bright white daub. Down its centre is a stack of dark oak loading doors, one per storey. At the apex a twin-log hoist beam sticks out three blocks over the pavement under a little hooded gable, with an iron chain and hook hanging from it. Two jettied storeys step out one block each over the street on rows of carved dark oak brackets. The timber store is lit by small shuttered windows and the loft by more. On the ground floor, a row of six open counters runs between dark oak piers. Each street has three wood merchants, and each shop is unmistakably its wood. North: OAK, with golden oak-log counters and an oak-plank awning; SPRUCE, dark brown, with spruce needles; BIRCH, white-barked logs and pale planks. South: JUNGLE in pinkish planks, ACACIA in bright orange, and DK OAK in chocolate brown. Each shop has its name in banner letters on a framed fascia, an awning of its own wood's stairs and trapdoors, log-end product panels on the piers, and a hanging sign under the jetty bracket. At the west end is a framed lobby on a deepslate plinth, with a double door and lantern-lit windows. At the east end a round-cornered timber arch opens onto a cobbled cart passage that runs right through the building. Lantern posts stand at the corners of the pavement.
concept_size: 39 wide, 30 deep (43 x 38 plot with both pavements), 3 storeys plus twin roof gables, about 34 high to the ridges
